manifest.name: dsh-live-spend
manifest.description: Live spend ticker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: what the current turn costs while the agent is still working, and what the session cost when it ends.

bundle.text:
# dsh bundle patch: inserts this plugin into a profile's layer stack.
- insert:
    - id: live-spend
      name: 'dsh-live-spend'

readme.text:
给 DeepSeek Harness 加花费显示：**输入框上方三行看整场对话花了多少、余额还剩多少、现在是峰价还是谷价；每条回答末尾一个数字看这一轮花了多少。**

```
● 本次 ¥2.375 · 余额 ¥94.840      ← 输入框上方，一直在，只有这个数字有滚动动画
当前为谷值价                        ← 当前计费时段
距离谷值结束还有 13小时12分钟        ← 距离下一次切换还有多久

本机目录：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "E:\日常工作区\dsh-live-spend"
```

GitHub：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jeff072333/dsh-live-spend
```

装完刷新一次页面；设置 → 插件 里会显示「实时花费」。卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-live-spend
```

| 位置 | 显示 |
| --- | --- |
| 输入框上方·第 1 行 | `● 本次 ¥2.375 · 余额 ¥94.840`：整场对话累计 + 账户余额，三位小数，跑动时数字持续上涨，新提问不会归零 |
| 输入框上方·第 2 行 | `当前为峰值价` / `当前为谷值价`：当前计费时段 |
| 输入框上方·第 3 行 | `距离下一次谷值价还有 X小时Y分钟`（峰值时）/ `距离谷值结束还有 X小时Y分钟`（谷值时） |
| 每条回答末尾 | `¥0.054`：这一轮的总消耗，答完才出现，往上翻历史能看到每一轮 |
| 还没花过钱 | 不显示，不占地方 |
| 读不到余额 | 显示 `余额 —`，花费照常统计 |

峰谷规则：**北京时间工作日 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为峰值价；其余时间（含周末全天）为谷值价，谷价是峰价的一半。** 第 2、3 行按本机时间每 30 秒刷新一次；计费本身按每次调用的实际时间戳算，所以在整点边界前后几秒可能对不上，其余时间一致。

每次模型调用结束时，DSH 会记录这一段的真实用量（未命中输入 / 缓存命中 / 输出 token），本插件按 DeepSeek 官方价目表折算：

| 模型 | 缓存命中 | 未命中输入 | 输出 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | ¥0.04 / ¥0.02 | ¥2 / ¥1 | ¥8 / ¥4 |
| `deepseek-pro` | ¥0.30 / ¥0.15 | ¥9 / ¥4.5 | ¥27 / ¥13.5 |

单位是「元 / 百万 token」，`高峰 / 空闲` 两档。高峰是北京时间**工作日 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00**，其余时间（含周末全天）按空闲价，空闲价正好是高峰的一半。联网搜索和网页抓取按 ¥0.005 / 次计。

余额数字能一直动，但要分清两种数：

- **准确的数**：每次模型调用结束，DSH 报一次真实用量，这一笔是准的。
- **中间的数**：两次调用之间，插件按上一步的"每秒花费"往前推，让数字持续下滑；下一笔真实用量到达时会被纠正，回合结束定格为准确值。

所以中途可能差几分钱，结束时一定对得上。

走**已登录的 DeepSeek 账号**，和「设置 → 账户」读余额是同一条接口（`account.getBalance`），不需要配置 API key。插件在页面打开时读一次，之后每 15 秒读一次，每次回答结束再读一次。

显示的是：**最近一次读到的平台余额 − 这之后已经花掉的钱**。平台余额本身要等回合结算后才变，所以这条减去的是本地账本，回合结束时自然对齐。

没登录 DeepSeek 账号、或接口暂时失败时，余额位显示 `余额 —`，花费统计不受影响。

- 只统计**当前会话**，不跨会话累计
- 只有 `deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-pro` 系列计价；其他模型只记 token、不计金额（底部会标注）
- 中途数字是估算，误差通常在几分钱以内
- 需要 DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** 及以上

```
index.js            Host 半：折叠 session/event 成会话投影 liveSpend
client.js           Client 半：注册到 conversation.input.dock，渲染那一行字并读账户余额
cordis.patch.yml    bundle 挂载声明
locale/{zh,en}.json 插件管理器里显示的标题与说明

```powershell
npm test          # node --test tests/*.test.mjs
```

Host 半零依赖（只用 Node 内置的 `fetch` / `setInterval`），Client 半只依赖 `react`。
MIT

Spend readouts for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): **three lines above the composer for the conversation total, the remaining balance and the current price period, plus one figure at the end of every answer for what that turn cost.**

```
● Session ¥2.375 · Balance ¥94.840     ← above the composer, always there, the only animated figure
Off-peak pricing now                    ← current billing period
Off-peak price ends in 13h 12m          ← time until the next switch

Peak windows are Beijing time on weekdays, 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00; every other hour, including all weekend hours, bills at half price. The period lines refresh from the local clock every 30 seconds.

From a local checkout:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "E:\path\to\dsh-live-spend"
```

From GitHub:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jeff072333/dsh-live-spend
```

Refresh the page afterwards. Remove with:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-live-spend
```

| State | Line |
| --- | --- |
| Turn running | `● Thinking ¥0.042 · Balance ¥96.53`, counting down |
| Turn finished | `Session ¥1.87 · Balance ¥95.11` |
| Nothing spent yet | hidden |
| Balance unavailable | `Balance —`, spend still counted |

DSH records real usage at the end of every model call (cache-miss input, cache-hit input, output tokens). This plugin prices those records with the official table:

| Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | ¥0.04 / ¥0.02 | ¥2 / ¥1 | ¥8 / ¥4 |
| `deepseek-pro` | ¥0.30 / ¥0.15 | ¥9 / ¥4.5 | ¥27 / ¥13.5 |

CNY per million tokens, `peak / off-peak`. Peak is Beijing time on weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00; everything else, including all weekend hours, bills at half price. Hosted web search and fetch calls are ¥0.005 each.

Two different numbers, deliberately kept apart:

- **Exact**: every finished model call contributes its own real usage record.
- **In between**: the ticker carries the observed cost-per-second forward so the figure keeps moving, then snaps back when the next real record arrives. The value on `turn/end` is exact.

Mid-turn digits can therefore be a few cents off; the settled number is not.

The plugin uses the **signed-in DeepSeek account** — the same `account.getBalance` path as Settings → Account — so no API key is needed. It reads once when the page opens, then every 15 seconds, and again when a turn ends.

The displayed figure is *the last platform balance read, minus spend accumulated since*. The platform balance itself only moves when a turn is billed, so this subtraction is what makes the number tick.

Signed out, or a failed read, shows `—`; spend accounting is unaffected.

- Current session only, no cross-session ledger.
- Only `deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-pro` families are priced; other models count tokens but no money.
- Mid-turn figures are estimates (usually within a few cents).
- Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** or newer.

```
index.js            Host half: folds session/event into the liveSpend projection, polls the balance
client.js           Client half: registers into conversation.input.dock and renders the line
cordis.patch.yml    bundle mount declaration
locale/{zh,en}.json Plugin-manager title and description

npm test
```
